עצם-מקרה.notes: THE conceptual hinge of Gate 4 ch.4: change and action belong to the Sefirot 'by accident, not by essence' (במקרה לא בעצם) — Aristotelian substance/accident. עצם='essence' (adj. עצמי='essential'; בעצם='by essence/essentially'); מקרה='accident' (במקרה='by accident/accidentally'; adj. 'accidental'). NB shares a root with עצמות (atzmut='essence', the Gate-4 theme): render both 'essence' but watch which is meant — עצמות = the divine essence/substance; עצם/בעצם here = the scholastic 'essentially'. The water/lantern parables turn on this: colorless light takes color 'accidentally' (in the beholder's view), never 'essentially', so no essential change touches the Emanator.

Pairs with the body/soul figure (גוף/נשמה) and the ABY"A nesting (each lower world a garment to the one above it).

ידע-בחירה.notes: The foreknowledge/free-will antinomy of ch.9 (Cordovero answering Rambam, Hilkhot Teshuvah 5 / Sefer ha-Madda). His solution: the two belong to DIFFERENT Sefirot, so there is no contradiction. ידיעה='[fore]knowledge' = Da'at = the concealed Tiferet ('He knows through Da'at'; 'by His knowledge the depths were split', Prov 3:20); בחירה='free will / free choice' = Malkhut ('from it downward, the two ways'; 'sin crouches at the door', Gen 4:7; also בית הבחירה). Before the deed, the knowledge of it 'in Da'at' makes no blemish (פגם), for 'God judges only [a man] as he is there' (Gen 21:17). 'Now I know' (Gen 22:12) puns ידע = know + union (Tiferet-Malkhut). Tiferet=mercy, Malkhut=judgment.

שפע-מינים.notes: The kinds of effluence — the resolution in ch.10 §6 (and the Gate of Essence and Governance, ch.3) to the worry that a withdrawal of providence would leave God 'lacking His rule.' (1) השפע התמידי='the perpetual effluence' — never lessens or increases; the essence that spreads forth, giving life to the attribute, so that even an attribute clothed in harsh judgment never loses it; this never withdraws. (2) התגבורת='the augmenting (intensifying) effluence' — that which raises/enlarges an attribute, or equalizes it to a higher one; THIS is what sometimes withdraws. (A third kind is treated in that gate.) See lexicon שפע for effluence itself.

פנים-אחור.notes: The ch.2 polemic against Sefer Me'irat Einayim's 'reversed' Tree. פנים='face'; אחוריים='back / hinder parts' (Exod 33:23 'you shall see My back [achorai] but My face shall not be seen'). מהופכת='reversed/inverted' (the disputed figure). Cordovero: the true figure is right-opposite-right, left-opposite-left (ימין אל הימין ושמאל אל השמאל). Proof-set this chunk: (a) the four tefillin parashiyot — קדש=Chokhmah, והיה כי יביאך=Binah, שמע=Chesed/Gedulah, והיה אם שמוע=Gevurah (see אברי-קומה) — via מניח='the one laying [tefillin]' vs קורא='the reader'(the onlooker facing him); (b) the altar's ascent — כבש='ramp' (on the south of the מזבח='altar'), turning to קרן דרומית מזרחית='the southeast corner' (the ascender's right); (c) ג' פסיעות='the three steps' [back, ending the Amidah] giving 'peace' to the left first (Yoma 53b). Verse: שויתי ה' לנגדי תמיד='I have set YHVH always before me' (Ps 16:8).

candidates.contextNotes: panim='face', achorayim='back/hinder parts', mehupekhet='reversed/inverted'; right-opposite-right vs the mirror reading.

decisions.rationale: Standard renderings; keep the face/back contrast and 'reversed' for the disputed figure; tefillin & altar orientation per existing limb-map.
